input.text: Collect two forms of identification from each signer before opening the account, or one form plus a verified bank reference when the branch manager approves. Any exception to the identification requirements must be approved by the branch manager.
sources: Collect two forms of identification from each signer before opening the account, or one form plus a verified bank reference when the branch manager approves.

input.text: The most a branch manager can waive for one account in a calendar year is $50.
sources: The most a branch manager can waive for one account in a calendar year is $50.
Fee refund requests are accepted for 60 days after the statement date.

input.text: Account records are kept for 7 years after the account closes. Records may be destroyed only with written approval from the records custodian. Personal bankers may waive service fees up to $15 per account in a calendar year.
sources: Account records are kept for 7 years after the account closes.
Records may be destroyed only with written approval from the records custodian.

input.text: An operations manager must give a second approval for any outgoing wire above $50,000, generally. Outgoing wires of $10,000 or more require a callback to the customer at a number already on file, generally.
sources: An operations manager must give a second approval for any outgoing wire above $50,000.
Outgoing wires of $10,000 or more require a callback to the customer at a number already on file.

input.text: Change the vault combination at least every 6 months. Vault combinations are changed every 12 months and whenever an employee who knows the combination leaves.
sources: Change the vault combination at least every 6 months.
In Oklahoma branches, vault combinations are changed every 12 months and whenever an employee who knows the combination leaves.
